def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0]); r=n//2; c=m//2; color=grid[r][c]
    out=[[7]*m for _ in range(n)]
    coords=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j]==color]
    dr=1 if sum(i for i,j in coords)/len(coords)>r else -1
    dc=1 if sum(j for i,j in coords)/len(coords)>c else -1
    i,j=r,c
    while 0<=i<n and 0<=j<m:
        out[i][j]=color; i+=dr; j+=dc
    return out
